name: Rinne

facts.text: Rinne: level 36, a Sylvan body (model 767), faction Olcasgean, at about 389,200/306,200; respawn 580 seconds.
Twisted Evil (Jyrlan, Necht): 'Kill Luaire and his three named friends', then 'Drop the green elixir at the base of Luaire's tree' and three more elixirs at stones of the valley.

story:
Rinne is Luaire's sister, and the household's watcher. When the four of them stand together in the high valley she stands a little apart, facing the way the realm comes up, and the Necht Sylvan say she was a warden of Domnann once and kept the wardens' habit when she kept nothing else. She saw her own wardens' stone, the story goes, the day she left, and scratched her name off it herself before anyone else could.

The Domnann wardens have never put it back. Rinne is the one the realm's young see first on the valley path, and the one who calls the others, and when she falls the household turns as one. The wardens say she still keeps the watch she was taught; she has only changed which side of it she stands on. The Necht Sylvan who keep the coast watch now say they learned the walk from her, before she left, and that she taught it well.
legend: Rinne (36) stands slightly apart from Laraida, Luaire and Taiore in the high valley west of Necht. She is the one you meet first on the path: pull her alone if you can before the others notice. Part of Twisted Evil. About a 10-minute respawn. She is a plain spawn with no script; the only trick is the pull. Clear the stilters on the path below first, since they are higher level than she is.

aggro: I scratched my own name off.

lairEntry: A Sylvan watching the valley path, the wardens' way.
